description: This stacked bar chart illustrates the number of datasets over time, categorized by target type. The horizontal axis, labeled "Year," displays chronological categories from 2012 to 2022. The vertical axis, labeled "Number of datasets," uses a linear scale with a labeled range from 0 to 160, featuring tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at regular intervals of 20. The data is represented by stacked bars, where the bottom segment in blue represents "Untargeted" datasets and the top segment in orange represents "Targeted" datasets, as defined by the legend titled "Targets." The total height of the bars generally increases chronologically from the shortest bar in 2012, which has a total value of approximately 2, to the tallest bar in 2021, which extends beyond the highest labeled axis tick to an approximate total value of 185 (consisting of roughly 110 untargeted and 75 targeted datasets). The bars are sorted chronologically by year. The final bar, representing the year 2022, has an approximate total value of 50 and is visually distinguished from the others by being rendered in faded, lighter shades of blue and orange. Additionally, the entire chart is presented at a tilted angle.
